Geometric affine H¹ section-surjectivity, the P¹ restriction input, and unconditional II.6.10 remain open. The pre-existing short copyright-header warning in `Chapter2ChiSlice.lean` remains.

The objective is partly advanced. The standing `fs-hartshorne` task remains `running` as required.
